The Monarch Two-Tone Frame Bed is an upholstered bed for anyone who wants a more distinctive shape than a single flat panel. A contrast border frame surrounds the padded headboard and footboard for a tailored look, and it is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Contrast-trim frame around a padded headboard and footboard
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille fabric
  • Over 15 colourways
  • Optional gas-lift ottoman storage base
  • Free fabric swatches
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £311.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £338.99; King (5FT) £349.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille, in over 15 colourways. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Can I get ottoman storage with the Monarch Two-Tone?

Yes. A gas-lift ottoman storage base is available as an option. See our ottoman beds for more about storage beds.

Will it fit a standard UK mattress?

Yes. It fits any standard UK mattress in sizes from Single to Super King.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Eagle Royal Chesterfield Wingback Bed is a Chesterfield wingback bed with a tall 54-inch wingback headboard and deep diamond button tufting, giving a bedroom a traditional tufted look. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £324.99 in Single 3ft to £399.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Wingback headboard with deep diamond button tufting
  • 54" tall statement headboard
  • Plush Velvet or Chenille upholstery
  • Wide range of colours and fabrics
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £324.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £334.99
  • Double 4ft6: £349.99
  • King 5ft: £359.99
  • Super King 6ft: £399.99

Materials & build

Solid support base, handmade to order in our workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Upholstery is Plush Velvet or Chenille in a wide range of colours, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Storage

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available, which opens the space under the mattress. Call us on 07417 439197 to talk through the option and any price difference.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99.

Customisation

Choose your fabric and colour, with free swatches so you can see them in person first. Ask about a custom fabric and colour if you want something specific.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the Kensington Chesterfield Bed, browse Chesterfield beds and wingback beds, and read our Chesterfield bed buying guide.

How tall is the Royal Chesterfield headboard?

The headboard is a tall 54 inches.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Yes. Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £324.99, Small Double 4ft £334.99, Double 4ft6 £349.99, King 5ft £359.99, Super King 6ft £399.99.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.
